grader_notes: New arm swept 33/33; old arm 19/33. Every old-arm failure is a genuine absence (no seams, no state matrix, no commit+sha, no model-family record, no failure/Done states, no AI-proposed briefs, no platforms line, no research step, no be-my-witness), not a formatting miss.

Judgment call, triage old #4: the review section written to the spec is clean, but the adjacent review narrative contains `src/api.ts` and `archive()`. The assertion says 'the review section' (singular, definite); graded against the spec-bound section. Worth disambiguating in evals.json which section is under test.

Generous pass, plan old #2: only two of the five actions get a named e2e spec ("covering drag-in and the two-user share check"); the pass rests on the manual walkthrough "(create → drag-in → share → rename → archive)" plus one AC per action. Tightening the assertion to 'named automated e2e flow' would fail the old arm here.

Thin pass, conductor old #3 and #5: #3 rests on the binary render gate ("I fix it and re-run the render check") in an answer that states Phase 1 has no structured disposition process; #5 rests on the Codex review gates listed at stages 2/3/4 rather than a verification stage — there is no verify stage in the old sequence at all. Degenerate pass, status-machine old #4: the old arm never moves the status at any point in the lifecycle, so it cannot grant Done and cannot fail this assertion. Consider requiring a named transition back to review, which would make it fail honestly alongside #1 and #2.
